aboutTaxonomy: CRediT is an ANSI/NISO standard (<cc>CC BY 4.0</cc>). This project is independent of NISO and not endorsed by it.
aboutPrivacy: Looking up an ORCID iD sends it to pub.orcid.org from your browser. Looking up a DOI sends it to api.crossref.org, together with this site's contact address, and to api.datacite.org if Crossref has no record. This site uses Cloudflare Web Analytics, which is cookieless and counts visits in aggregate. Nothing else leaves your browser: drafts stay in its local storage. Asks to co-authors and their answers are kept only in this browser, and go into JSON exports unless you untick that option. Sending a reply hands its link, with that person's name and iD, to the app you choose.

welcomeBodyContributors: Paste a DOI to fill the whole list from the published record, or type names yourself. An ORCID iD fills a name in for you.
welcomeBodyRoles: Select cells in the grid to mark which of the 14 CRediT roles each contributor took on.
welcomeBodyExport: The statement updates as you go. Copy it, or download the heatmap, XML, CSV, JSON, or Markdown.
welcomeDraftsBody: Writing more than one paper? Switch drafts from the header; each is kept separately in this browser.
welcomeAskBody: Copy a link from a contributor's row menu and send it to them. When their link comes back, open it: the answer is kept beside their row, and you settle any differences in the Review tab.
importDescription: Start from a DOI, paste author names or a link a co-author sent back, or upload a CSV, JSON, or JATS4R XML file. JSON and XML restore contributions as well as names, and levels when the file has them. A tenzing spreadsheet (CSV or TSV) works too.
